The target job now uses Swift Testing's process-wide --no-parallel mode for cross-suite native database isolation while focused runtime tests retain the required internal concurrency coverage. The local Supabase job and MCP test step are non-production verification for the Client and Project provider slices; no hosted resource, credential, export, deployment or cutover step exists.
